messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v5.17.3 -> eu-west-1 (25%) started. Tag: feat/kv-fallback. Rolling window 10m.

mike: seeing a 502 spike in eu-west-1 right after the canary started. small % but customer-facing. graphs show a ~2% error rate spike. @jamie can you confirm?

jamie: ack, looking at ingress logs. tailing now.

ops-bot: pager: mike is oncall for infra, escalation sent. :rotating_light:

jamie: logs show upstream 502 responses from inference-svc pods that started with new image. stack traces point to kv-fallback path. snippet: ```502 GET /v1/generate  upstream returned 502 /var/log/proxy```

mike: impact estimate: ~2% of EU requests failing for ~3m, no obvious data loss. correlates with canary rollout start.

elin: can we disable the kv-fallback feature flag immediately? that's fastest mitigation.

jamie: issuing toggle now -> `/ff toggle kv-fallback --env=prod --value=false`

deploy-bot: feature-flag: kv-fallback set to false by jamie at 4765123820 :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT-2026 created: "eu-west canary 502 spike" Severity: Sev2. Owner: mike. Linking graphs and first-response checklist.

mike: thanks. if the flag flip doesn't hold in 2m I'll abort the rollout and prepare to revert the single commit. @sara can you prepare a revert PR just in case?

sara: on it. prepping PR that reverts commit c3f2a1e in service repo. will request urgent review.

jamie: after the flag flip errors dropped back to baseline. monitoring for 10m to ensure stability.

elin: confirmed metrics: error rate back to normal for 4m. recommend 1) pause/stop canary rollout, 2) cut hotfix with revert commit, 3) notify customers.

mike: pausing rollout and pinning canary to previous revision. command used: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-svc --to-revision=42```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by mike at 4765125060.

sara: PR created: revert-feat-kv-fallback (#4127). CI green, marking for urgent review and merge on approval.

support-bot: Support blurb drafted: "We saw a brief spike of 502 errors in EU following a canary deploy. We disabled a new feature flag which mitigated the issue. We're preparing a small hotfix; no user data was lost."

ops-bot: Handoff: @jamie to monitor for 2h and escalate if error rate >0.5% for 5m. Postmortem owners: mike / sara / jamie.

jamie: starting hotfix canary v5.17.4 (single-commit revert) to eu-west-1 for verification, will not progress rollout until green for 15m.

deploy-bot: v5.17.4 canary deploy started at 4765125410.

incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigation in place, transitioning to postmortem. Owners set; postmortem doc scheduled (ETA 24h)."
